planting.note: Plant pups or container-grown stock in spring in extremely well-drained, sandy to rocky, lean soil in full sun; Marginata bears the classic century plant rosette form but with bold yellow margins along each blue-green leaf.

directions: Set pups or nursery plants slightly proud of grade in gritty, fast-draining soil in full sun; good drainage is essential, since standing water quickly rots agave roots. Marginata is one of the most widely planted variegated agave cultivars, forming the same enormous, architectural rosette as the straight species but with each thick, blue-green leaf boldly edged in bright yellow, a striking two-tone effect that makes it a strong focal point in xeriscape and coastal plantings. Sharp marginal teeth and a stout terminal spine line each leaf, so site it away from foot traffic. Like other true agaves it is monocarpic, sending up a tall flower stalk after years of growth and then dying back while leaving a ring of offsets that can be replanted to continue the planting.
